title: Game mode
description: modes/<id>/mode.yaml: a game mode, a way to play the packs' content, and the options its games fix (packages/game/modes: parseGameMode, docs/modding/modes.md, docs/architecture/game-variants.md).

name.description: The localization key of the mode's name.

description.description: The localization key of the mode's line in the mode list.

ruleset.description: The ruleset a new game of the mode starts with; one of rulesets.

rulesets.description: The rulesets the new game's rules screen may choose from; with one, the screen is not shown.

battle.description: The battle system a new game of the mode plays: classic (the original's) or folder (docs/architecture/folder-battle.md); classic when left out.

battles.description: The battle systems the mode's player may switch between; battle is one. Only battle when left out.

order.description: Where the mode goes in the mode list: lower first, then by id.

options.description: The options of the options page (ui/api/options.lua) the mode's games fix, by name, at one value each (true, false, a value of a choice or a whole number); the options page shows them locked while one of its games is played.

randomizer.description: Whether a new game of the mode may be a randomized run (docs/modules/game/randomizer.md). Off by default.
